## Submission checklist

- [ ] I added or updated exactly one MCP server entry under `servers/<category>/<slug>/`.
- [ ] The entry has a stable public URL.
- [ ] The entry category matches its folder.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs`.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`.
- [ ] I confirmed `README.md` is generated and committed if it changed.
